Results.ReviewText: I'm a minimalist and this grill is perfect as I do not need a shiny cabinet or side burners.  I just want to grill steaks, burgers, chicken and ribs.  This grill is perfect size for my family of four adults.  I'm very brand loyal to Weber.  My mom taught me:  "Only the rich can afford to be cheap".  Meaning if you are rich, you can afford poor quality as you will always be replacing or repairing.  Spend money on quality, it pays off in the long run!
Results.Title: Happy Griller!!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased this grill so I've only used it a few times. However, so far so good. It cooks evenly across the grill (which is unfortunately unusual with grills), and I love the fact that the grates are reversible for different types of foods. The size is great for a family, but if you entertain multiple families for parties you might want to go with a 4 burner grill. Lastly, the legs are thick and sturdy so it doesn't wobble when you wheel it around. My only complaint is that it is quite simple for a $500 grill, but IF it lasts longer than a few years before rusting out like other brands then it will be worth it. Time will tell.
Results.Title: Nice grill for the family

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
